answer: A rotating beacon publishes a fresh ticket every 10 minutes, and each agent must lock 50 POA for 24 hours to claim one, tying one identity to one ticket. Admission also needs a vouch from an established vertex in the trust graph, so a newcomer arrives like a tributary joining a river: the flow is visible and traceable. If an identity is caught duplicating, its stake is slashed and its voucher loses reputation, making each fake cost at least 50 POA plus a burned relationship - far more than one fake can earn.
